summary: HA Sustainable Infrastructure Capital filed a Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus supplement for $500M of 7.850% Green Junior Subordinated Notes due 2057, with an expected original issuance date of November 24, 2026. The notes pay 7.850% to the June 1, 2032 first reset date, then reset to the five-year Treasury rate plus 3.164%, floored at 7.850%. Interest is semi-annual from June 1, 2027, and the issuer may defer payments. The notes are subordinated to senior indebtedness and rank junior; this is an ordinary debt takedown, not a special situation.
